description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' encapsulates Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface to facilitate flexible logging mechanisms. It provides methods to set and get the next logging node in a chain, and overrides the println method to output logs through Android's Log system, attaching stack traces when necessary.
external_methods: Log.println(int priority, String tag, String msg)

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, allowing it to be integrated into a chain of log nodes for flexible logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message using Android's Log system, attaches stack trace if provided, and propagates the log to the next node in the chain.
